title: Why We See Faces in Clouds
short_teaser: Human brains are highly tuned to recognize faces and meaningful patterns.
story: Human brains are highly tuned to recognize faces and meaningful patterns. That ability is useful for social life, but it also means we sometimes find familiar forms in random shapes. Pattern recognition is powerful, yet it becomes wiser when paired with a willingness to verify. Curiosity loosens assumptions. A better question can reveal options that certainty would have hidden. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
